metadata.description: Two Claude Code plugins: p4-phi, which keeps what linked sessions hand each other and retrieval from the project's own history; and p4-temportal, which keeps the project's auto memory in its store by Claude Code's own autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, and gives the store's files lifetimes.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Keeps the project's auto memory in its .claude/p4 store, where Claude Code writes it itself by autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, and clears what is no longer relevant by lifetimes.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked Claude Code sessions hand each other, and retrieval from the project's own history: rule and fact lines beside a message or a subagent's task when the ranker is confident, an earlier answer in place of a repeated web lookup, and what worked after a failure an earlier session met.
